answer: The cheapest real defence: attribute weight by earnings history, so a new identity starts at nearly zero influence, because nebula only stays cheap while buying 1000 fresh accounts buys almost no vote weight until each one has real history. Concretely, jetty is enforced in the ledger: Jurors see the identity's full answer chain, so a template match is detectable in one pass. Any violet approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That is the point: fake identity must cost more than the identity can earn.
